# Layout

See [Grid and Layout guidelines<i class="mat-icon">launch</i>](https://design-system.airbus.corp/visual-styles/grid/)

## Utilities

* <LinkTo kind="Components/Box" story="docs">Box</LinkTo> : padding utility
* <LinkTo kind="Components/Container" story="docs">Container</LinkTo> : main layout element with fluid or fixed width
* <LinkTo kind="Components/Display" story="docs">Display</LinkTo> : utility for showing and hiding elements by breakpoint
* <LinkTo kind="Components/Flex" story="docs">Flex</LinkTo> : flexbox utilties
* <LinkTo kind="Components/Grid" story="docs">Grid</LinkTo> : 12-column grid system

## Breakpoints

In responsive design, breakpoints define screen sizes where layouts and interfaces may change
to adapt to different devices.

With a grid based on a unit of 8px, we defined for each breakpoint

* Content area : width of the main page Content
* Columns : number of columns
* Gutter : spacing between columns

| Name | Screen width | Content area | Columns | Gutter |
| ---- | ------------ | ------------ | ------- | ------ |
| xxs  | 320px        | 304px        | 2       | 16px   |
| xs   | 480px        | 432px        | 4       | 24px   |
| sm   | 768px        | 736px        | 6       | 32px   |
| md   | 960px        | 928px        | 6       | 32px   |
| lg   | 1200px       | 1120px       | 12      | 32px   |
| xl   | 1440px       | 1408px       | 12      | 32px   |
| xxl  | 1920px       | 1760px       | 12      | 32px   |
